name: Architecture · transition, hybrid sites and cloud
purpose: A mid-migration snapshot of a multi-site estate: the sites boundary on the left with three site stacks in different states (cut over, replicating, not started), the cloud boundary on the right with the central API, sync service and cloud database, dashed replication and routing paths, wave badges and the shared state legend.

source_advisory_slots.note: 3 named sites, each a local UI and local DB with a state, plus a +N more strip
API layer, sync service, database; names 20 chars
